observations: Black 3D printer with a vertical spool holder at the top.
The brand 'CREALITY' is visible on the extruder housing in photo 0 and photo 2.
A control panel with buttons and a rotary dial is located on the right side of the printer.
The build plate is a dark, textured surface.
A white filament spool is mounted on the top spool holder.
The printer is shown in a static, assembled state.
A watermark 'TOVIDE BUSINESS WORLD' is present on all images.

claims.evidence: The brand is visible, but the specific model name and version are not legible on the printer in the photos.
A spool is shown, but its weight and material type cannot be confirmed from the photos.
This is a technical specification that cannot be verified through photos of the exterior.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have a faulty motherboard.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and reaching the home screen.

risks.risk: The extruder may not heat or may have a clogged nozzle.
risks.proof: A video showing the nozzle heating up and successfully printing a test line.

risks.risk: The filament spool may be empty or contain a different material than PLA.
risks.proof: A photo of the spool label or a video showing the filament being dispensed.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and navigating the control screen.
Video of the printer extruding filament and printing a test pattern.
Photo of the model name and version label on the printer chassis.
Photo of the filament spool label showing weight and material.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
